summaries.plain:
Billing/invoice synchronization fixes, refund minimums, documentation guidance, and Grafana updates are complete and committed on `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; dashboard ID is `grafana/d/mpgfsa`, and the Twilio retry guardrail remains removed. Invoice pagination is implemented but uncommitted: API/service support `limit`/`offset`, with 18/18 invoice tests, pagination coverage, Ruff, and diff checks passing.

Invoice-summary performance work is nearly ready to commit. `build_summary` now performs one aggregate query per account and batches currency conversion. Tenant 73 improved from approximately 39 seconds/2,417 SQL statements to 4.3–4.5 seconds/37 queries while preserving aggregate values. All 63 report tests pass (2 PostgreSQL skips), and Ruff passes. Temporary profiling/SQL instrumentation remains in `_load_invoices`; review and likely remove it before committing.

PDF work is also uncommitted. Credit/negative lines are no longer omitted, zero-value lines remain skipped, and money formatting uses the shared locale-aware `format_money()`. Exact grouped-currency formatting coverage was added. Page-height calculations now consistently use point-to-inch conversion, preventing over-reservation that caused an 86-item invoice to render as three pages rather than two. PDF tests pass (14 passed, 1 skipped), broader billing tests pass (83 passed, 4 skipped), golden PDFs remain byte-stable, and `git diff --check` is clean. Four files currently differ (217 insertions, 184 deletions); visual comparison of three generated PDFs is the remaining useful validation.

Main ongoing priority: assign each ledger posting event a unique immutable identifier and expose it in ledger history. Secondary work: enforce the config/deploy extraction restriction and clean up monthly events via cutoff selection, range/partition inspection, dry run, deletion, and vacuum.
summaries.structured:

Invoice PDF work is also uncommitted. The renderer now preserves nonzero negative credit amounts so credits appear immediately after related items, and it uses the shared locale-aware `format_money()` helper. Currency grouping tests cover `1000`, `-12345.6`, and `0`. Page-height calculations were centralized through `_row_height()`. Repeated table-header reservation was reduced by calculating it once per document, restoring continuation-page headers and fixing excessive pagination. Validation passes: all invoice PDF tests (`14 passed, 1 skipped`) and the broader billing suite (`83 passed, 4 skipped`). Golden PDFs remain byte-stable.
